The available High Output 6.7L Cummins® Turbo Diesel I6 engine delivers commanding
responsiveness. The 420-horsepower High Output version is the lineup’s most powerful, is
paired with the AISIN® 6-speed automatic transmission and offers impressive available
diesel torque—up to 1,075 lb-ft on Ram 3500. The AISIN delivers seamless shift quality,
thanks to a sophisticated transmission controller, a state-of-the-art dual-core processor, a
robust ring gear, a large thrust bearing and heat treatments for select components.
The standard-output 6.7L Cummins Turbo Diesel I6 yields 370 horsepower and 850 lb-ft of
torque and is teamed with the long-proven 68RFE 6-speed automatic transmission. The 68RFE
features a proficient filtration system and bandless design that helps reduce maintenance
requirements. Dual fluid filters, a dual-face torque converter lockup clutch for the 2nd through
6th gears and an integrated Tow/Haul Mode provide an alternative shift schedule. Whichever
powertrain you choose, you’ll receive outstanding performance and superb cold-start ability.
